conventions.scalarKinetic: L=-(D Phi)^dagger(D Phi) in covariant mostly-plus notation
conventions.spin23Ontology: H2(R) response geometry, not a second physical time

vacuum.globalSelectionQualification: P is one of three discrete eigenprojector minima. The benchmark chooses it; S_v1 does not derive why this minimum is realized.

projectorSector.localCoordinates: z1,z2 in the CP2 tangent at P0
projectorSector.qualification: A and kappa are benchmark inputs of the allowed V_resp form, not quantities derived by S_v1.

gaugeFixing.procedure: canonicalize K, orthogonally diagonalize the gauge mass matrix, then use R_xi gauge in the mass basis
gaugeFixing.functional: L_gf=-sum_i (partial.V_i-xi m_i G_i)^2/(2 xi), with partial.V_gamma for the photon
gaugeFixing.cohomology: two photon polarizations and three polarizations for every massive vector; Goldstones, longitudinal gauge representatives and FP ghosts cancel from the physical cohomology

physicalBosonicModeCount.qualification: Fermions are excluded from the numerical count because the Yukawa and Majorana matrices are not fixed.

selfAdjointDomain.boundaryCondition: periodic fields, gauge parameters and ghosts
selfAdjointDomain.operatorDomain: H^2(T^3) for each Laplace-type physical fluctuation operator
selfAdjointDomain.qualification: This certifies a boundary-free periodic benchmark. It does not certify the orbifold fixed plane or a physical defect edge.

certifiedAtTreeLevel: the gauge kinetic matrix is positive definite
all displayed physical bosonic mass-squared eigenvalues are nonnegative
all canonical physical pole residues are positive
the periodic quadratic operators are self-adjoint and lower bounded
the linear gauge-fixed BRST cohomology has the stated physical polarization count

minimalGlobalObstruction.statement: An existence witness for one healthy completion cannot certify the underdetermined candidate action whose coefficient functions, selector data, Yukawa/Majorana tensors and defect domains are not fixed.
unresolved: the programme does not derive this parameter point or the projector reference tensor A
the full Yukawa and Majorana spectrum and its coupling to projector fluctuations are unspecified
fermion and defect loops may change the scalar/projector Hessian and kinetic mixing
the localized defect matter spectrum and parity anomaly are unspecified
the orbifold/fixed-plane self-adjoint domain and boundary BRST complex are unspecified
the metric is only a source; no dynamical gravitational physical-state sector is defined
no RG interval is supplied over which all positivity inequalities remain valid
